headline: What Makes Norfolk Southern (NSC) a New Buy Stock
summary: Norfolk Southern (NSC) has been upgraded to a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy), reflecting growing optimism about the company's earnings prospects. This might drive the stock higher in the near term.
